acceptanceCriteria: Mutating operations detect current branch and working-tree state before writing.
Protected/default branches require explicit routing to a selected or newly created review branch.
Pre-existing tracked and untracked changes are preserved.
Confirmation and completion UI identify the destination branch.
Tests cover clean and dirty worktrees, protected branches, and branch-creation failure.
component: Resolve I-0031 and GitHub #177 across workspace configuration, mutation coordination, and AgileCockpit UI.
componentsAffected: Resolve I-0031 and GitHub #177 across workspace configuration, mutation coordination, and AgileCockpit UI.
notes: Never silently mutate a configured protected branch.
rationale:
AgileCockpit writes workflow mutations to whatever branch is checked out, including protected or default branches, and can disturb pre-existing working-tree changes. This task detects branch and worktree state before writing, routes protected-branch mutations to a selected or newly created review branch, and identifies the destination branch in the UI.

Constraint: Never silently mutate a configured protected branch.
testSteps: Unit, integration, and UI tests plus a branch-safety manual scenario.
